summary: Gives store planners a live view of on-hand stock across warehouses and shelves, with reorder alerts tuned to seasonal demand. Reduces stockouts on high-velocity SKUs during peak shopping windows.
Lets category managers set replenishment rules per store cluster and watch fill rates update in near real time. Flags slow-moving SKUs for markdown review before they tie up shelf space.
Guides stockroom associates through scheduled cycle counts on a handheld scanner, reconciling variances against the perpetual inventory ledger automatically.
Turns any store handheld into a receiving and put-away scanner, matching purchase orders to delivered cartons and posting discrepancies to the inventory team's queue.
Runs weekly demand forecasts per store-SKU combination using historical sales and local event data, feeding recommended order quantities into the replenishment pipeline.
Powers the in-store checkout terminal with fast card, tap, and mobile wallet tendering, letting cashiers split payments and apply loyalty discounts in a single flow.
Equips floor associates with a tablet-based checkout so they can ring up sales anywhere in the store during line-busting events, syncing every transaction back to the main register.
The core cash-drawer register application used at fixed checkout lanes, handling cash reconciliation, till counts, and manager overrides for price adjustments.
A stripped-down checkout app for pop-up shops and seasonal kiosks that only needs a phone and a card reader, with sales rolling up into the main store ledger overnight.
Unifies in-store, curbside, and buy-online-pickup-in-store transactions under one tendering flow so associates no longer switch apps depending on how the order originated.
Lets shoppers check point balances, browse redeemable rewards, and enroll in the loyalty program from the storefront or in-store kiosk.
Tracks every earn and burn event on a member's loyalty account and surfaces a readable transaction history to both members and support agents.
Manages loyalty tier thresholds and perk assignments, automatically upgrading or downgrading members based on trailing twelve-month spend.
Automates birthday and anniversary offer sends to enrolled members, letting the marketing team configure templates without engineering involvement.
Gives store managers a console to enroll top spenders into the invite-only VIP tier and track redemption of concierge-style perks like personal shopping appointments.
Lets merchandisers drag and drop products onto a digital shelf layout and push the finished planogram to store printers and handheld guides.
Helps category managers decide which SKUs belong in each store's assortment based on local sales history, freeing up shelf space for better-performing items.
Schedules seasonal window and endcap display changes across the store fleet and confirms compliance with photos submitted by store staff.
Assigns promotional endcap space to vendors and internal campaigns for each planning cycle, preventing double-booking of high-traffic display locations.
A shared calendar view of every seasonal reset, promotional wave, and vendor display change planned for the year, used to coordinate merchandising and store operations.
Assigns incoming tasks, like restocking or spill cleanup, to whichever associate is nearest and free, based on the store's live task board.
Builds weekly associate schedules against forecasted foot traffic and lets employees swap shifts with manager approval built into the workflow.
Walks store managers through opening and closing checklists on a tablet, timestamping completion so district managers can audit compliance remotely.
Guides district managers through in-person store walk audits with a standardized scorecard and photo capture, rolling results up into a regional dashboard.
Displays each store's daily sales goals, staffing notes, and safety reminders on a shared screen used during morning team huddles.
A drag-and-drop page builder marketing teams use to assemble and publish category and campaign landing pages without waiting on a code release.
Embeddable cart and product-tile widgets that let any internal team stand up a shoppable page in minutes while inheriting the main storefront's checkout logic.
Generates browsable catalog pages directly from product feed data, keeping pricing and availability in sync without manual page edits.
A headless commerce toolkit that partner brands use to build fully custom storefronts on top of the shared catalog and checkout APIs.
Spins up short-lived branded microsites for flash sales and brand partnerships, then automatically retires them once the campaign end date passes.
Decides which warehouse or store should fulfill each online order based on stock, distance, and shipping cost, rerouting automatically if the first pick fails.
Directs warehouse pickers through the most efficient pick path for a batch of orders and confirms each item scanned before it reaches the pack station.
Splits multi-item orders across shipments when a single location can't fulfill everything, while keeping shipping costs within the customer's promised rate.
Notifies store staff when a curbside customer arrives and tracks time-to-trunk so managers can spot bottlenecks in the pickup process.
Sends buy-online-pickup-in-store customers a text the moment their order is bagged and waiting, with a QR code the store associate scans to release it.
Gives the returns counter a single screen to look up an order, process a refund or exchange, and print any needed labels without touching three separate systems.
Lets online shoppers generate a prepaid return shipping label from their order history page and tracks the package until it's scanned back into inventory.
Tells warehouse staff whether a returned item should go back to sellable stock, liquidation, or disposal based on condition codes entered at intake.
Scores incoming return requests for serial-return and wardrobing patterns, queuing suspicious cases for manual review before a refund is issued.
A self-service kiosk that lets shoppers process an online return in-store without waiting for an associate, printing a receipt once the item is scanned in.
Calculates markdown and promotional pricing across the store fleet and pushes updated price tags to electronic shelf labels overnight.
Lets marketing schedule time-boxed flash sales down to the SKU level and automatically reverts pricing to the regular rate the moment the window closes.
Recommends the next markdown step for aging seasonal inventory based on sell-through rate, giving buyers a suggested price and timing before margin erodes further.
Lets category teams build and target percent-off and buy-one-get-one coupon offers, with built-in guardrails against stacking conflicting discounts.
Monitors competitor pricing on matched SKUs daily and alerts pricing analysts when the store's price falls outside its intended competitive band.
Tracks inbound shipments from distribution centers to individual stores, giving store managers an ETA and unload window for each incoming truck.
Shows buyers the live status of every open purchase order, from vendor acknowledgment through receipt, flagging orders at risk of missing their ship window.
Gives suppliers a self-service portal to confirm orders, submit advance ship notices, and view scorecards on their on-time delivery performance.
Analyzes historical vendor lead times and highlights which suppliers are trending slower, so buyers can adjust safety stock before a shortage hits.
Follows a pallet's journey from the receiving dock to the sales floor, timestamping each handoff so operations can find where shelf-ready delays occur.
Gives regional managers a dashboard of conversion rate, basket size, and repeat visit trends broken down by store, updated each morning.
Mines transaction data for common product pairings, helping merchandising decide what to place near checkout or bundle into a promotion.
Turns in-store sensor data into a heatmap of where shoppers linger, used to evaluate whether a new layout or display is drawing attention.
Scores loyalty members on likelihood to lapse based on declining visit frequency, feeding a re-engagement offer queue for the marketing team.
Lets marketing analysts build custom customer segments from purchase and demographic attributes and export them directly into campaign tools.
The autocomplete and typo-tolerant search bar embedded on the storefront, ranking results by relevance, stock, and margin.
Lets shoppers upload or snap a photo of an item they like and returns visually similar products from the current catalog.
Powers predictive query suggestions as shoppers type, drawing on trending searches and the shopper's own recent activity.
Generates personalized product recommendation rails for the homepage and product pages based on browsing and purchase history.
Lets catalog managers configure which attribute filters, like size or color, appear on each category's search results page without a code change.
